[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 9 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]12Beyond wave 17, '''Flying Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |hidden = No |fly = {{Attr|Fly|Yes}} |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Flying Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had low health and an average speed, but it was a [[Flying]] enemy, meaning only a few towers could target it. Beyond wave 17, its health would increase over time. ==Appearance== The '''Flying Ducky''' is a white duck with black eyes and an orange beak and feet. It also has wings which it spreads out and constantly flaps, which allows it to fly. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *The best counters to the '''Flying Ducky''' are the [[Sniper]] and [[Executioner]]. **A Level 2 [[Sniper]] can instantly defeat a '''Flying Ducky'''. **As these enemy spawns in hordes, the [[Executioner]]'s multi-hitting attacks can deal with it very well. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFlyingDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Flying Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyFlyingDuckyIconIG.png|'''Flying Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History == *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Flying Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Flying Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Flying Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Flying Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Flying Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]|Wave 8|Flying Ducky|Wave 9|[[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Flying Ducky}}
